name: Zebediah Love

tenures.role: promoter — the door of his own office reads "Zebediah Love, Promoter"
tenures.source: Tsunami Oni's own UWF roleplay of 7 September 2004, "You never forget your first time..." (/promotions/uwf/rp/promo-774.html, accession 0002) — a flashback narrating his American debut for NPW, the only document that stages the promotion at all.
tenures.note: Staged in the flashback's own scene: he interviews the new signing personally, in an office off the gym, and screens him for piracy before booking him.

caption: The promoter of No Pirates Wrestling, a tall unblinking man who looks more like a mortician than a booker and who screens every new hire for piracy on behalf of three generations of family grievance.
notes: His own statement of the promotion's single rule, verbatim: "This here is No Pirates Wrestling and that means one thing. No pirates. I can stand anything else... But no pirates. My daddy hated pirates. His daddy hated pirates. And I hate pirates too."

name: Buck Naked

tenures.source: Tsunami Oni's own UWF roleplay of 7 September 2004, "You never forget your first time..." (/promotions/uwf/rp/promo-774.html, accession 0002) — a flashback narrating his American debut for NPW, the only document that stages the promotion at all.
tenures.finisher: powerbomb — billed by the character himself as "the most feared powerbomb in the South"
tenures.note: Staged in the flashback as the promotion's welcoming committee: he meets the new signing in the gym, walks him to the promoter's office, and wishes him luck in the locker room before the card. No match of his own is narrated.

identity.note: Bare-name collision only with euwc-buck-naked ("THE IRONMAN" BUCK NAKED), a documented wrestler of the fwrestling.com-era EUWC whose own corpus is separately held. Nothing connects the two: different fed, different community, different decade, no shared document, and no merge evidence of any kind. "Buck Naked" is a gag name the hobby produced more than once. Filed per the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule.

caption: A hefty middle-aged nudist who wrestles in a cowboy hat, cowboy boots and a bandana and nothing else, and who explains at length that the arrangement is a competitive advantage.

name: Esinem

tenures.source: Tsunami Oni's own UWF roleplay of 7 September 2004, "You never forget your first time..." (/promotions/uwf/rp/promo-774.html, accession 0002) — a flashback narrating his American debut for NPW, the only document that stages the promotion at all.
tenures.note: The opponent in the one NPW match the record narrates, and its loser: a kick to the jaw knocked him out and the referee counted three with a foot on his chest.

caption: A young trash-talking wrestler in hip-hop clothes whose in-ring persona turns out to be a masochist's, thanking his opponent for every chop and asking for more.
notes: Billed with short blond hair and hip-hop attire. The name's etymology is not stated anywhere in the corpus and is left unresolved rather than guessed.
